{{Top|leg}}
'''Im'Tra'Tal''' was a city located on the planet of [[Coyn]]. The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Im'Tra'Tais]] or "Princeland", the most luxurious on the planet, was located in this city as well.
